stories.summary: Watch: Israeli forces open fire on an elderly Palestinian in Gaza’s Beit Lahia A video posted on social media shows an elderly Palestinian civilian trying to pass through an area as Israeli forces open fire on him, with bullets hitting the ground nearby, in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza. stories.headline: Israeli forces open fire on an elderly Palestinian in Gaza’s Beit Lahia

opening: A video posted on social media shows an elderly Palestinian civilian trying to pass through an area as Israeli forces open fire on him, with bullets hitting the ground nearby, in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza.

Israeli attacks across the besieged enclave remain ongoing despite a ceasefire that came into effect in October.
